notes.title: Update 250911
notes.content:
The demo has been updated with the following features:

1. Changed the player's poetry attack mode to a more strategic one, combining poems.

2. Added a bobing game mode.

3. Overall graphical improvements.

notes.title: 250612 Update
notes.content:
Added the function of old records in battle

Many players mentioned that they wanted to hear some opera songs. The studio searched for a lot and finally found some old records that are more than 100 years old. You can choose them as background music in the game. Of course, you can also ignore this function.
